title: Stanley Black & Decker Announces 4th Quarter 2026 Dividend

body_markdown:
NEW BRITAIN, Conn.


, Oct. 29, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Stanley Black & Decker ( **NYSE: SWK** ), a global leader in tools and outdoor solutions, announced today that its Board of Directors approved a regular fourth quarter cash dividend of $0.84 per common share. The dividend is payable on Tuesday, December 22, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on Tuesday, December 1, 2026.


**About Stanley Black & Decker**


Founded in 1843 and headquartered in the USA, Stanley Black & Decker **(NYSE: SWK)** is a worldwide leader in Tools and Outdoor, operating manufacturing facilities globally. The Company's approximately 41,000 employees produce innovative end-user inspired power tools, hand tools, storage, digital jobsite solutions, outdoor and lifestyle products, and engineered fasteners to support the world's builders, tradespeople and DIYers. The Company's world class portfolio of trusted brands includes DEWALT®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, BLACK+DECKER®, and Cub Cadet®. To learn more visit:[www.stanleyblackanddecker.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810296-1&h=537975306&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.stanleyblackanddecker.com%2F&a=www.stanleyblackanddecker.com) or follow Stanley Black & Decker on[Facebook](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810296-1&h=1924918557&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fstanleyblackanddecker&a=Facebook) ,[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810296-1&h=1963329756&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fstanleyblackdecker%2F&a=Instagram) ,[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810296-1&h=630494451&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fstanley-black-decker-inc&a=LinkedIn) and[X](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810296-1&h=2816033642&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FStanleyBlkDeckr&a=X) .
